split_rule.confirmation: project_split=holdout_confirm_reserved (fresh reserve frozen in the ledger)
split_rule.exposed_eval: project_split in holdout_dev_exposed / holdout_confirm_exposed: already used for validation, never train, not a fresh confirmation
split_rule.excluded: quarantine or other; reason per row

git.note: ext_data is not committed; code identity = code_tree_sha256

supervision_channels.human_mturk_votes: raw soft vote count per ~2 s clip (MTurk, coverage-weighted, relative within video); explicit human selection only where votes > 0
supervision_channels.human_unselected: votes == 0: nobody selected it; weak, NOT a reliable negative
supervision_channels.relative_preference: pairs of clips of the same video ordered by votes (aicext.release.preference_pairs)
supervision_channels.auto_match: match_label 1/0/-1 from edited-video matching; -1 = not reused by the uploader, NOT a human negative

YouTubeHighlights.vote_detail_available: only per-clip soft totals are published; per-worker votes, number of workers and worker ids are not available

not_included.MrHiSum: separate feature-only release mrhisum_feat_subset_v1 (no raw video)
